posts.title: fishing resort might be the greatest game of all time
posts.description: From the human perspective, there is basically an infinite amount of worthwhile art in the world. This is both good and bad. It's good because there's always something to choose from. It's bad because you will never get to experience it all. So how do you choose what to engage in? I don't know.
